name: codelab-runner
description: Interactive server of the CodeLab plugins for Moodle: runs programs (C, C++, Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Pascal, PHP, Bash, Go, Rust, R, Ruby, Lua, Kotlin, Perl, Octave, SQL) in a sandbox, interactively and for grading.
author: Boban Blagojević
